content: 2:1-12 Pol gigit Tesalonaika end sarau ebeter end wurinob qamb igo
Io, an yonou wau ima gas ende, qoan in qunan animbogoub yaremin eng, in yarab anit sarau ebetemin eng ar isi me isau.

Qoan in ginam Pilipai end isune iningaramb git goan ba borusiari uter iningarer eng an mom inimbigomanei. Ego ininou Qenu innonogursia in munon qarau end wurit uburab me isau. Ue, in mom qigimiet igo Qenu qob uber dibes aninob qamb igunei.
Qen end in qob aninob qamb igoun eng, qob soagensi ger me aninob qamarau. A qen big qiyo, a anmurimar ger me qamarau.

Ue, Qenu wonou inwariget aba in mom nonoguretrune gab sarau abar qamb inimbiga qob uber qamb igunei. End bo see qob dibes quraun eng, munon ininou sarau eng gab qen inimbagaiar qamb ue, Qenu wonou in qen inimbeg qamb. Wonou ininou misir qomon eng gugum qerei igo.
An mom inimbigoumon eng. In gag-gag qob uber ger me aninob qamb igoun, ue ar. In mi ger qenunget wogub sarau ar git goan big ebet igoun qi eng Qenu diban inimbag igo.
In munangit qen inimbagaiar qamb qiyo, a an qen inimbagaiar qamb, a munon qei qen inimbagaiar qamb gor ue.
Ego in Munon inubersiau tari wonou imbigau yurau igoun. End wot igub an taui mi indarar qamb qomorun eng uber. Ego qoan in anamar igoun eng, wau ber ger unor musub qi qoat igo gas ende anamar igunei.
In eng ansi igoun eng, in sig mom anqenungar ne Qenu qob uber eng aninob qamb igunei. Qanam end gari ue e, in sig-sig mom anqenungar ne ende at an uput qamb in umun eng uber ende qamb.

Io, an yonou wau ima gas ende, eng in anit sarau qen gugum qeretutnob ebet qer omboat igoun eng an mom qoyam. Qenu qob uber aninob qamb igoun qen end in itum woromt ininou mi niau sarau ubune an me quguraget igamau.
In qomon an munon oabig igoumon eng ansi igoun eng an inimbigari ne Qenu gor inimbig igo. In qomon eng ebet igoun eng, qomon qau ne qoregen ar, qomon soagen ger ue.
In gari-gari ansi igoun eng wau ur qomon qoregen imbig igo gas ende ansi igunei.

An quguragetarari antoubar qenen annonogursi igunei. An Qenu wonou qomon eng qoregen mom toat qib igoarar qamb. Wonou anit ara yarari wonou bibis end igo ne wonou ginamt end ar qenen ibeibi igoarar qamb qenen ibitiri annonogursi igunei.
2:13-16 Tesalonaika wuri mom nonoguret igour end qugurau gamir end me uburab isau

Qanam ger in Qenut mismisir nob qamb igoun eng ete: In Qenu qob qoan aninob qumurune igumon end. An qob igumon eng munangit qob qamarari igau gas ende ue. Qenu wonou qob apand eng igomanei. Qob eng igub oabigumon eng annonogursi igo.

Io, yonou wau ima gas ende, an qomon abataman gas ende gari Yudia munon eng gor ende ebetemirei. Wuri Munon inubersiau tari Yisas wonou munon yurau burab Qenu tenori mom igurei. An aninou munon yurau anquguragsi igour gas ende wuri gor Yuda ende wurisearari quguraget igurei.
Yuda wuri der Munon Aib Yisas waramirei, ne qob gigit qamarau munon igaramirei, ne in gor inqarausiaur. Qenu qomon eng abari ibag wurisiningoar waga wuri der munon gugum wurinob yogub igour.

In munon yurau ar eng Qenu qob wurinob qumurune oabig erogori igoarar qamb oboun eng, wuri intaisi igour. Qenu qubeieminer end wuri iet igour. Eng at igour end wurinou qomon boru eng aibet isa Qenu qo ibag wurit misiringetar eng ten igo.
2:17-20 Pol Tesalonaika bo ibegeib qamb misir igub igo

Io, yonou wau ima gas ende, see qen piten menman me qi gaun. Git eng apand, ego in misir eng an in nob erogori igamau gas ende igo. End ne in maigas ebet werei ger gab yarab bo menman animbogoun qamb anit eabsi igoun.
Qen geret in yarab animbogouboun. Yonou gari qenen yar animbegeib at igoum, ego Satan mom intaisi igo.
In mi eng ebet igoun eng qen geret ininou Munon Aib Yisas bo igeser dara in meimi bauboun? Meimit mismisiruboun? Taui qamb meimi uber ger ba uberoruboun? An gari.
In anit sarau ebet igoun end an animbag-animbag in unum dibenara mismisiruboun.
